copy.headline: Marvel’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Won’t Screen for BAFTA, Golden Globes and Other Early Awards Groups
copy.caption: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes will fight Doctor Doom in the latest Avengers installment, but they won’t face the first wave of critics and major guilds on the awards calendar.

story.title: Marvel’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Won’t Screen for BAFTA, Golden Globes and Other Early Awards Groups to Guard Its Spoilers (EXCLUSIVE)
story.summary: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes will fight Doctor Doom in the latest Avengers installment, but they won’t face the first wave of critics and major guilds on the awards calendar. Marvel Studios’ “Avengers: Doomsday” will not screen for awards voting bodies before its world premiere, Variety has learned exclusively, a move designed to protect its theatrical run …
